But supply is NEAR_AND_REJECTING (dist 0.58 ATR) with RECLAIM_REJECTED_BELOW_SUPPLY and a strong buy-bubble cluster (s4/m4) signalling accumulation. The intermediate is split: BULL_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION primary vs BEAR_PULLBACK_TRAP secondary.
conditioning_principal: in a recovering range, a shallow pullback with buy-bubble accumulation reads as continuation - but supply rejecting at <0.6 ATR overhead is the trap risk; the two readings sit in genuine tension
factors_meaning_changed: the buy-bubble cluster (s4/m4) recasts the small down-bar as accumulation rather than failure; but RECLAIM_REJECTED_BELOW_SUPPLY at 0.58 ATR is the same trap signature seen at 9432, here softened by neutral SL and shallow drop
qualitative_confidence: medium-low - the bull-pullback continuation label and buy-bubble accumulation are encouraging, but price is pinned right under rejecting supply (0.58 ATR) in a still-broken macro; the ceiling is too close for a confident long
invalidation_triggers: rejection wick at the supply 0.58 ATR overhead; close below the pullback low without reclaim; buy bubbles ceasing while price stalls under supply; macro distribution re-asserting
uncertainty_notes: the immediate overhead supply is the dominant uncertainty - if price cannot push through within a bar or two, the BEAR_PULLBACK_TRAP secondary reading takes over

factors_meaning_changed: DEMAND_ABSENT/floating is benign here because the base is right beneath and the breakout has no flush (contained, low drop_atr); NO_FLUSH + clean sky make the breakout orderly rather than a chase
qualitative_confidence: medium - cleanest of the recovery-phase entries (orderly breakout, clean sky, contained drop, calm RSI, buy bubbles), but macro_broken is still TRUE and there is no demand base if it fails, so conviction is tempered
invalidation_triggers: close back below the 5177-5185 base; loss of clean sky (supply appearing overhead); macro tilting to clear distribution; flush/cascade re-igniting
uncertainty_notes: still inside a macro-broken backdrop, so this constructive local breakout could be a counter-trend pop; the low drop_atr and clean sky are what make it the most takeable of the cluster

conditioning_principal: a climactic flush that is reclaimed with a bull CHoCH and bottom_turn = the canonical legitimate-bear-buy / capitulation-reclaim; sell-pressure exhaustion at a reclaimed low is bullish
factors_meaning_changed: the huge -209 down-bar is NOT a trap here because it was immediately reclaimed (climax + reclaim valid) and structural SL is OK; washed-out RSI 32 is exhaustion/opportunity not weakness; CHoCH 2-bars-ago confirms the turn
qualitative_confidence: medium-high - this is the strategy's edge pattern (climax reclaim, bottom turn, fresh CHoCH, SL structural OK, supply far). Conviction held just short of high because macro is still broken and the reclaim is only ~2 bars old
invalidation_triggers: close back below the 4996 flush low (reclaim fails); CHoCH bull invalidated by fresh bear BOS; bottom_turn reverting; capitulation-reclaim flipping to continued cascade
uncertainty_notes: reclaims this fresh can be retested; the entry is a moderate green bar after a violent two-way day so a shake of the low before continuation is possible, but the structural setup is favorable

conditioning_principal: sell-bubbles + supply blocking the target 1 ATR overhead in weak/low-fuel tape = distribution/rejection risk, NOT a buyable dip; the bounce has no fuel to reach target through blocking supply

invalidation_triggers: sell-bubbles clearing and a decisive reclaim/acceptance above the blocking supply; momentum strengthening (weak->strong); fuel returning; a clean bull CHoCH above supply
uncertainty_notes: DISCOUNT + low RSI can mean it is cheap, but with supply blocking and sellers active the bounce is more likely to fail at the ceiling; SL_TOO_SHORT also means poor structural protection
